mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS membershipId, m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, m.status, m.applied_at AS appliedAt FROM membership m JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = m.role_id WHERE m.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY m.status ASC, m.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS clubId, c.name AS clubName, c.description AS clubDescription, tu.nickname AS teacherName, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, m.status FROM membership m JOIN club c ON c.id = m.club_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = c.teacher_id AND tu.deleted = 0 JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = m.role_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
